original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.ces_refresh_runner import refresh
from meta.sas.tools.update_bundle_index import update
from meta.sas.tools.export_panels_index import export_panels_index

out = {}
out['ces_refresh_logos_iv'] = refresh(agent='Logos IV')
out['bundle_index'] = update()
out['panels_index'] = export_panels_index()
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
